SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT SEQ FROM EPRO_MRO.DBO.SAMYANGGROUP_RFQ_CMS_IF_S WHERE REVIEW_STATE IN ('사전검토결재(승인)') AND REVIEW_APPROVAL IN ('N','Y') AND REVIEW_RCV_DATE IS NULL
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'MSDS_R' AS DOC_TYPE , 'SYGP' AS BUYER , PRODUCT_ID AS KEY_NO , REVIEW_APPROVAL AS DATA01 , REVIEW_REMARK AS DATA02 , ATTR1 AS DATA05 FROM EPRO_MRO.DBO.SAMYANGGROUP_RFQ_CMS_IF_S WHERE 1=1 AND SEQ = '$G_RS.SEQ$'
UPDATE EPRO_MRO.DBO.SAMYANGGROUP_RFQ_CMS_IF_S SET REVIEW_RCV_DATE = GETDATE() WHERE 1=1 AND SEQ = '$G_RS.SEQ$'
